$comment: Patterns end in (?!\n)$ because Python re, which jsonschema uses, lets $ match before a final newline and ECMA-262 does not; the lookahead keeps both engines in agreement.
title: Record
description: Frontmatter of one Record in a Bank. Write every value as a scalar or a flat list of scalars.

schema.description: Set to 1, the Record schema version.

id.description: Give the Record a unique 10-character nanoid from [A-Za-z0-9_-] and never change it.

memory_type.description: Pick exactly one memory type: Decision, PolicyRule, Exception, or Context.

title.description: Name the Record in a short, non-empty line.

status.description: Set the lifecycle state. A proposed Record is a Proposal: agents surface it but never treat it as a constraint.

date.description: Record the date the Record was written or last accepted, as YYYY-MM-DD.

effective_from.description: Set the YYYY-MM-DD date the Record starts to apply, if it applies later than its date.

effective_to.description: Set the YYYY-MM-DD date the Record stops applying, such as the end of an Exception.

last_confirmed.description: Set the YYYY-MM-DD date someone last confirmed the Record still holds. Only move it forward.

review_by.description: Set the YYYY-MM-DD date by which someone must review the Record again.

summary.description: State the claim and its scope in one sentence.

superseded_by.description: Name the one id of the Record that superseded this one. It holds a single id, while supersedes is a list.

supersedes.description: List the ids of the Records this one supersedes. Fill superseded_by on each of them too.

promoted_from.description: Name where this Record came from when promoted out of a repo's working memory.

promoted_to.description: Name the Bank Record this item was promoted to, as <bank>:<id>.

subject.description: Reserved. Accepted here, and v1 ignores it.

applies_to.description: List the Facets where the Record applies, each as <prefix>:<value> using a prefix the Bank declares.

owners.description: List the Facets that own the Record, each as <prefix>:<value>, such as team:commerce-architecture.

tags.description: List free-form keywords for search. Use applies_to, not tags, to say where the Record applies.

source_refs.description: List the sources the Record was drawn from, such as URLs, file paths, or PR references.

related.description: List links to other Records, each as <relation>::<id>, such as constrained_by::<PolicyRule id> on an Exception.

additionalProperties.description: Keep a key the schema doesn't define to a scalar or a flat list of scalars, never an object or a list holding one.

date.description: A calendar date written as YYYY-MM-DD.

facet.description: A Facet written as <prefix>:<value>, with a lowercase prefix.

scalar.description: A string, number, boolean, or null.
